name: quiet-journey-v1
status: experimental; derived from creator guidance and three comparable uploads
measurement_scope: three quiet-story uploads by The Sleepy Shack, not all sleep stories

format.purpose: Establish a comfortable place and a simple reason to be there. A separate host welcome is optional.
Give the character one benign, concrete thing to do.
Describe small actions in a clear physical sequence, with relevant sensory observations.
Finish a small task or arrive at a comfortable stopping place; avoid a suspenseful reveal.
Continue softly into the next activity, or reduce novelty near the episode ending.

rules: Use distributions as guidance; do not stretch or shorten every sentence to match a number.
Keep viewpoint and physical object states consistent.
Do not add rare adjectives or new characters merely to raise vocabulary diversity.
No copied reference prose is supplied to the writing model.
Paragraph size is an engineering choice, not a measured caption property.
Semantic coherence and user preference remain separate review requirements.

runtime_policy.narration_word_budget: not revised yet; decide continuous narration versus narration plus ambience before full drafting
